# Design by Nasir

Independent graphic design studio of Nasir Hussain, based in Karachi, Pakistan, working with clients worldwide.

## Services
- Brand Identity Systems - logo, colour, type, stationery
- Album & Cover Art - record sleeves, single art, artwork systems
- Social Media Design Kits - post templates, story sets, ad creative
- Poster & Print Design - event posters, flyers, large format
- Motion & Animated Visuals - logo stings, title sequences, animated posts

## Typical price ranges
Brand identity from $800 / Cover art from $250 / Social kits from $400 / Posters from $200 / Motion from $350
